text: Split a large bedroom to make an office.
Three years later you retire, stop needing the office, and open the bedroom back up.
Four bedrooms, a living room, a den, an office, two bathrooms, a kitchen and a dining area.
We have all the allotments of a domicile.
But much of that space could be reallocated more efficiently, because the way we need it changed over time.
I was gone for six years.
Three people became four, and eventually the same house will be too much for one person.
The dome does not have that problem.
